item.title: Beginning the Psalms: Worshiping God in Every Season of Life
item.description: In this introductory episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins begins a 150-day journey through the Book of Psalms, explaining their authorship, structure, themes, and Christ-centered focus while preparing listeners to read one Psalm per day.

item.title: Inside Bethel: False Prophecy, Signs, and the Sufficiency of Scripture
item.description: Justin Peters interviews Jesse Westwood, a former Bethel insider, about false prophecy, modern signs and wonders, and why the sufficiency of Scripture must guide Christian discernment.

item.title: Wives Respecting Their Husbands: God’s Design for Marriage
item.description: What does Scripture mean when it calls wives to respect their husbands? In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains Ephesians 5:33 and God’s design for respect in Christian marriage.

item.title: Psalm 1: The Blessed Life Rooted in God’s Word
item.description: Psalm 1 stands as the gateway to the entire book of Psalms, presenting two paths and two destinies—the way of the righteous and the way of the wicked. In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 1 to show that true blessing is not found in prosperity, ease, or human success, but in a life rooted in the Word of God.

item.title: Biblical Womanhood: Strength, Wisdom, and Grace in Christ
item.description: In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins teaches on biblical womanhood from Genesis 2, Titus 2, 1 Peter 3, and Proverbs 31, showing that womanhood is not weakness but strength rooted in Christ.
